root_cause.text: The driver increased the number of PTP (Page Table Page) entries to 4 to support more playback streams, but the `ct_vm_map()` function always uses only the first PTP page (`vm->ptp[0].area`), causing an out-of-bounds access and page fault when total memory allocations exceed the capacity of a single PTP page.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states: "ct_vm_map() always uses PTEs in vm->ptp[0].area regardless of CT_PTP_NUM. On AMD64 systems, a single PTP covers 512 PTEs (2M). When aggregate memory allocations exceed this limit, ct_vm_map() tries to access beyond the allocated space and causes a page fault." The patch reverts CT_PTP_NUM from 4 to 1, confirming the fix. The oops trace shows a fault in `ct_vm_map` during playback preparation.
